items.text: Kurudzi rwakanga rusina kudana kuzita rangu
uye vanopedza usiku hwavo vachinyengetera vari munzira yakavanda:
uye hari dzavo dzine furo renyama yakasvibiswa;
"Sezvazvakangoita kana musvi uchiri kuwanikwa musumbu ramazambiringa
uye vanhu vachiti, 'Musauparadza, muchine zvakanaka mauri,'
uye nokubva kuna Judha avo vachatora makomo angu;
uye Mupata weAkori uchava uvato hwemombe
uye munozadza zvirongo newaini yakavhenganisirwa Magumo,
uye mose muchakotamira pasi kuti mubayiwe,
Varanda vangu vachaimba zvichibva mumufaro wemwoyo yavo,
asi achapa varanda vake rimwe zita.
uye kuti vanhu varo vave mufaro.
kana mutana asingasvitsi makore ake okurarama;
